issues.description: Inconsistent collection resource path for retrieving all persons: the template's PersonResource defines the GET mapping as @GetMapping("persons") while the solution's PersonResource defines it as @GetMapping("people"). The problem statement and tests refer to endpoints under "/persons" (e.g., PUT /persons/{personId}/parents). This naming mismatch between template, solution, and problem statement/tests will cause confusion and failing requests in tests that expect "/persons".
issues.suggestedFix: Make the resource path consistent across all artifacts. Update the solution's PersonResource mapping from @GetMapping("people") to @GetMapping("persons") so it matches the template, problem statement, and tests (or alternatively update the problem statement/tests/template to use "people" everywhere). The recommended change is to use "/persons" to keep the API consistent with the rest of the exercise.
